source.instrument: Capstone 5.0.7 x86 32-bit disassembly over a read-only PE32 section mapping; ghidra CLI xrefs as leads. Event release uses ghidra-cli 0.2.2 disassembly and xrefs checked against the same PE32 image. Button source uses ghidra-cli 0.2.2 disassembly, RTTI and xrefs checked against original file-backed PE32 bytes. Supplied-context eligibility uses the same ghidra-cli exports and original PE bytes, independently decoded by Apple LLVM objdump 21.0.0

scope: Consumer of the 0x78-byte Sqwt command-parameter record: the Executed routed event from the command raise to the handler store, the form-level handler, the kind-to-variant switch, the Lua entry points and the subscription gate. Command semantics of individual UILuaCommands are Lua behavior and are not established here.

scriptInterface.requestDepthLimit: 0x00896d33: reject when the nesting count at +0x14 is 8 or more

parameterObjects.pushOrder: string0 (nil when empty), string1, string2, then the variant values

mouseIngress.additionalGate: Snapshot of element +0x3ae mask 0x20 taken before optional refresh is set.

mouseGates.handled: After the base call, byte behind args +0x10 is zero.
mouseGates.eligibility: element +0x15a byte mask 0x20 is set. Semantic name UNKNOWN.
mouseGates.refreshMaskClear: After 0x009157c0 returns, clear mask 0x10 in the state byte.
mouseGates.downPropertyUpdate: After optional refresh, update only when (state & 0x03) != 0 and (state & 0x20) == 0. Write state | 0x24 before 0x0099c680.
mouseGates.upPropertyUpdate: After optional refresh, update only when (state & 0x03) != 0 and (state & 0x20) != 0. Write (state & 0xdf) | 0x04 before 0x0099c680.
mouseGates.upSnapshotOrder: Snapshot state mask 0x20 after the base call and handled/eligibility gates, before optional refresh. The later ClickMode 2 branch uses that snapshot.

click.forwardingGate: A dword at interface +0x2fc temporarily points to a local byte. If that byte equals 1 after the optional Command call, set Click args +0x17 to 1 and skip generic forwarding. Otherwise restore the saved pointer and forward.
click.resultPropagation: For each nonzero Click result, write byte 1 to original mouse args +0x19 for handled, and to corresponding bytes +0x14 through +0x17 for those flags.

storedCommand.stackArgumentWidths: Three 32-bit pointers. At callee entry: [ESP+4] record, [ESP+8] selected target interface or null, [ESP+0x0c] Click args.

routedCommandJoin.scope: Conditional on the stored command using this RoutedCommand slot. Other ICommand implementations are not covered.

executedForwarding.order: FrameworkElement and base handler store precede specialised Button logic.

buttonSource.confidence: STATIC for instructions, pointer/RTTI data and conditions. INFERRED for naming the packed value bit and for Click EventTrigger ordering conditional on attachment.

descriptor.initializerForm: routedEvent static checks hold one row per descriptor initializer found by a sweep of .text for calls to the constructor; the id 0x21 has no row

wildcard.matchRule: a handler whose event descriptor has id byte 0x59 matches every event the store dispatches

target.fallback: dynamic cast of the trigger event source at +0x8 to Sqwt::FrameworkElement

route.listOrder: target and its parents are appended in that order, the root last, then the list is reversed once
route.bubble: traversed from the list end, target first and root last
route.tunnel: traversed from the list start, root first
route.direct: recipient slot 13 of the target only

interface.senderIs: the owning element object passed to the constructor

handlerObject.invoke: this = target + adjust, stack arguments (sender, args), callee pops 8

registration.order: the form registration calls the remove thunk then add, so a handler is present at most once per store

sites.target: root element, only when a gate object was created

sites.adds: a form helper listener with its own function 0x00533f30
sites.target: element from the form control map

formGate.role: per widget pad UI controller consulted before the subscription lookup, present only for forms whose root name minus its first 7 characters is one of the listed names

popupHelp.role: positions the popup help window element before Lua delivery continues; it does not stop delivery

selectorGates.confidence: STATIC for supplied-argument, field, instruction and publication joins. Runtime instance identity and field meanings remain UNKNOWN.

gates.condition: main ItemManager map M+0x8 returns no nonzero value for local dword key 0
the AL returned by 0x00763030(S) is nonzero and byte P+0x161 is nonzero
